title: docs: Update README
description:
How would I render the README with minimal changes? My goal was to include the new-ish rchk runner.

Also, should the `rhub_platforms()` function have an example that is run in pkgdown mode only (`Sys.getenv("IN_PKGDOWN")`)?

title: Build message with paste0 to avoid extra spaces
description:
Current message display for me:

```
  ‘xxx’ is not validated, or does not match the package
  maintainer's email. To validate it now, please enter the email
  address below. Note that R-hub will send a token to this address. If
  the address does not belong to you, quit now by pressing
  ENTER .
```

The space after `ENTER` can't be build with `paste()`, so we should switch to `paste0()`.

title: Installing Bioconductor for R >= 3.6.0
description:
because [biocLite]()https://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R) now has: 

```r
if (vers >= "3.6"){
        stop(
            "With R version 3.5 or greater, install Bioconductor ",
            "packages using BiocManager; see https://bioconductor.org/install",
            call. = FALSE
        )
    }
```

I'm not sure how to set the repos, hence the commented lines: 

```
    # echo "options(repos = BiocInstaller::biocinstallRepos())" >> ~/.Rprofile
    # echo "unloadNamespace('BiocInstaller')" >> ~/.Rprofile
```

This probably fixes https://github.com/r-hub/rhub-linux-builders/issues/42

title: Rename vignette to appear as 'Get Started'
description:
Hi,
According to [`pkgdown` documentation](https://pkgdown.r-lib.org/articles/pkgdown.html#navigation-bar) in default configuration a vignette named the same as the package can directly appear as `Get Started` in the navbar so it is more accessible.
So I propose to rename the `Get Started` vignette to benefit from these default options.

```r
as.numeric(units = "secs", Sys.time() - parsedate::parse_iso_8601("2018-04-19"))

```
